title: B1/B2 as alternatives: on which saint's epoch, when the date has 2-3 saints?
prompt: Your answer to #12: "alternative antiphons: B1/B2 are two alternatives for the same office → LAUDS.antB option 1 / option 2. TP at the end would indicate antiphons to be used during Paschaltide. I'm not sure about TpA so we can leave that one unknown until we start going through the queue." Carried so far: part = LAUDS.antB, B1 = option 1, B2 = option 2, TP → option_txt 'Tempore paschali', TpA rows stay unassigned. Still open: EVERY B1/B2 row is on a date with two or three saints in the OCO TOC (3/2 'Die 3: S. Blasii' + 'Vel: S. Ansgarii'; 8/2 Jerome Emiliani + Josephine Bakhita; 9/10 Denis & companions + John Leonardi; 16/10 Hedwig + Margaret Mary Alacoque; 25/5 Bede + Gregory VII + Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi (B3); 19/10 Brébeuf & companions + Paul of the Cross, …). Which epoch(s) get the two options? The same answer will be applied to M1/M2/M3 (#16) unless you say otherwise there.

pages.note: 3/2: Die 3 S. Blasii / Vel: S. Ansgarii
